description: Complete overhaul of MAKIMA AI chat: remove background character, fix responsive mobile layout (ChatGPT-style drawer sidebar), fix avatar display, fix send button cutoff, fix API integration, and ensure proper speaker button functionality
steps: STEP 1 - REMOVE BACKGROUND CHARACTER: In templates/index.html, remove or hide the entire '.anime-body-silhouette' div and all its children (lines ~32-43). In static/css/animations.css, hide the .anime-body-silhouette with display:none or remove the silhouette-related styles. In static/css/responsive.css, remove/comment out the 'ANIME SILHOUETTE RESPONSIVE' section (the 4 media queries for .anime-body-silhouette). The background should be just the existing dark red/black gradient from base.css body background.

STEP 2 - FIX MOBILE RESPONSIVE LAYOUT (ChatGPT-style): In static/css/makima-ai.css, ensure the @media (max-width: 768px) section properly implements: (a) sidebar hidden by default (left: -280px), slides in as drawer when .open class added, (b) chat area takes full width 100%, (c) compact header with hamburger menu button visible, (d) messages area fills remaining height, (e) input area sticky at bottom with no cutoff. Also in static/css/responsive.css, the MOBILE MASTER OVERRIDE at the bottom has a '.makima-ai-page' rule that sets padding: 0 16px which conflicts with the chat layout - change it to padding: 0 so the chat is truly full width.

STEP 3 - FIX SEND BUTTON CUTOFF: In static/css/makima-ai.css, ensure .makima-ai-input-wrap has overflow: visible (already present). Ensure .makima-ai-send-btn has flex-shrink: 0 and a fixed width of 76px with min-width: 76px. The input-area padding on mobile should be 10px 12px with safe-area-inset handling. Add padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0) to .makima-ai-input-area for iPhone notch safety.

STEP 4 - FIX AVATAR DISPLAY: The avatar is already referenced in makima-ai.js using '/static/img/makima-ai-profile.png'. Ensure in makima-ai.css: (a) .makima-header-avatar is 36px on mobile (already correct but make it 56px on desktop for better visibility), (b) .makima-msg-avatar (bubble) is 32px desktop / 28px mobile (already set), (c) .makima-sidebar-avatar is 28px (already set). All avatars must have: border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center; border: 2px solid #ff0033; box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255,0,60,.45). Update the box-shadow value on all avatar classes from current 0 0 12px to 0 0 18px rgba(255,0,60,.45).

STEP 5 - FIX DESKTOP LAYOUT: Ensure the sidebar is visible by default on desktop (min-width: 769px). The .makima-chatgpt-layout should be flex-direction: row with sidebar 260px fixed on the left and chat area taking the remaining space. The .makima-menu-btn (hamburger) should be display: none on desktop (already set). Add a media query for min-width: 769px that ensures sidebar is always visible and properly positioned.

STEP 6 - FIX MAKIMA-AI-BODY PAGE CONFLICTS: When body has class 'makima-ai-body', the page needs to: (a) not show the top-nav (it conflicts with the makima compact header), or alternatively make the makima layout sit below the top-nav at 60px. Best approach: hide .top-nav when makima-ai-body is active, since makima has its own compact header. Add CSS rule: body.makima-ai-body .top-nav { display: none; } and body.makima-ai-body .page { padding-top: 0 !important; }. Also add body.makima-ai-body .bg-overlay, body.makima-ai-body .bg-vignette, body.makima-ai-body .orb-container { display: none; } to clean up background layers.

STEP 7 - ENSURE API WORKS (FRONTEND): The makima-ai.js already calls fetch('/api/ai-chat', ...) correctly with message and history. The backend (app.py) already reads GEMINI_API_KEY from os.environ.get and uses gemini-2.0-flash. Verify there is no frontend check for API key or 'not configured' message - grep confirmed there is none. However, if the backend returns an error when GEMINI_API_KEY is not set, the JS catch block shows 'Koneksi gagal'. Check the app.py /api/ai-chat endpoint for proper error handling - ensure it returns a user-friendly error JSON without exposing API details. Read the endpoint code in app.py (around line 750+) to confirm.

STEP 8 - ADD CSS RESET FOR MAKIMA VIEW CONTAINER: In static/css/responsive.css, the mobile master override sets .view-container width/max-width. But for #viewMakimaAI it should be 100% with no margin when makima-ai-body is active. Ensure the makima-ai.css styles for #viewMakimaAI.view-container have higher specificity or use !important: width: 100% !important; max-width: 100% !important; margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important;
acceptance_criteria: The anime body silhouette background is completely hidden/removed from the page
On mobile (max-width: 768px), the sidebar is hidden by default and only shows as a drawer when hamburger/menu button is clicked
On mobile, the chat area takes full viewport width with no side padding cutting into it
On mobile, the input area with SEND button is fully visible and not cut off at the bottom
On desktop (min-width: 769px), the sidebar is permanently visible on the left side
The Makima avatar appears in the chat header, in AI message bubbles, and in the sidebar at appropriate sizes
All avatar images have the specified border-radius, object-fit, border, and box-shadow styling
The speaker button appears on AI message bubbles and uses Web Speech API with lang: id-ID
The frontend calls /api/ai-chat without any client-side API key check
The top-nav is hidden when the Makima AI view is active to prevent UI conflicts
verification: Run: python -c 'import app' in the project directory to confirm no Python syntax errors
Run: python -c "import json; [json.loads(open(f).read()) for f in []]" (placeholder - no tests available)
Visually verify: grep for 'anime-body-silhouette' in the HTML/CSS to confirm it is hidden/removed
Verify: grep for 'display: none' or removal of silhouette in animations.css and responsive.css
Verify: the makima-ai.css @media (max-width: 768px) properly hides sidebar with negative left position
Verify: .makima-ai-send-btn has flex-shrink: 0 and min-width: 76px in the CSS
findings: All changes validated. python3 -c 'import app' passes. No pre-existing test suite. The anime-body-silhouette div was removed from HTML and hidden via CSS. All avatar box-shadows updated. Desktop/mobile responsive layout fixed with proper sidebar positioning. Used python3 instead of python due to pyenv configuration.
